scenarios.description: A row-0 talent is purchasable from an empty tree; one rank costs one point
A rank beyond the entry's max rank is rejected; the state is unchanged
With a configured usable budget of 3 points the 4th point is rejected
An imported build spending more than the usable budget is invalid
Row 1 needs 5 points spent in Arms row 0; 0 and 4 points are not enough
The 5th point in Arms row 0 unlocks row 1
Points in another tab do not count toward an Arms gate
Deep Wounds needs Improved Rend fully ranked: 2/3 is not enough, 3/3 is
A rank nothing depends on can be refunded
Improved Rend cannot drop below 3/3 while Deep Wounds is purchased (no cascade); refunds that keep every gate satisfied are allowed until a gate breaks
Refunding a row-0 point that a purchased row-1 talent's gate needs is rejected
A 3-rank talent refunds one rank at a time down to 0; then nothing is left

Mortal Strike's gate counts the whole Arms tab including itself, but is evaluated before the purchase: 29 other Arms points are not enough, 30 are (the capstone is the 31st point); an import with 29 + capstone is invalid
Imported: 29 other Arms points + Mortal Strike - not obtainable by any purchase order
Imported Deep Wounds with nothing else: gate and prerequisite both fail; actions on an invalid build are refused until it is fixed
Imported: a rank above max, a rank-0 allocation and a node listed twice
A node id that is not in the tree: rejected on spend and on import
An imported allocation of a node that is not in the tree
Spending with the entry of another node is rejected
An imported allocation naming another node's entry
Nature's Splendor has the only RequiredForAvailability edge of Forever: Nature's Majesty must be fully ranked (1/2 is not enough)
Intimidation has two SufficientForAvailability edges (Bestial Swiftness, Bestial Wrath); one fully ranked source is enough

Bestial Wrath <-> Intimidation are mutual sufficient prerequisites: no deadlock (Bestial Swiftness roots the cycle), Bestial Wrath cannot be taken before Intimidation, and the root cannot be refunded - the cycle cannot support itself
With the tab gates met but no Bestial Swiftness, neither cycle member is purchasable (each only has the other as an active source)
Imported Intimidation + Bestial Wrath without Bestial Swiftness: the two support each other statically but no purchase order reaches them -> invalid
Venom carries TraitCond 50984 (node + group + spend in one row), whose semantics are unresolved: never purchasable, even with every proven rule met
An imported build containing Venom cannot be verified -> invalid
SYNTHETIC (Forever has no node with two Required edges): Improved Overpower gets Required edges from Improved Heroic Strike and Improved Rend; both must be fully ranked
SYNTHETIC: a node with both a Required and a Sufficient edge - the combination is not proven, so it is never purchasable
SYNTHETIC (Forever has no selection nodes): selection semantics are not verifiable on real data, so a selection node is never purchasable
SYNTHETIC: TraitNodeFlag.NeverPurchasable (2) blocks purchase
SYNTHETIC: an unobserved TraitNode.Flags bit (ActiveAtFirstRank, 16) fails closed
SYNTHETIC: TestGridPositioned (8), observed on real Forever nodes, does not change allocation
SYNTHETIC: an entry type other than SpendSquare (1) fails closed
SYNTHETIC: an unresolved condition on a prerequisite makes it unpurchasable, so its dependents can never become available either
